blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
Tom and I haven't seen each other since we were children.
blocks.note: لم أرَ سامي مذ كنا صغارًا.

blocks.text: I wish I had more friends.
I wish I knew where he was!
I wish I could go to Japan.
I really wish to see you today.
I wish you had more time for me.
blocks.note: أتمنى أن يكون لديك وقت أكثر لي.

blocks.text: I wish she could be here with us.
I wish I could remember her name.
I wish I had been kind to her then.
I wish you would do as you're told.
blocks.note: أتمنى أن تفعل ما أُمِرت به.

blocks.text: I wish that I could do more to help.
blocks.note: تمنّيت لو كنت قادرا على تقديم المزيد من المساعدة.

sentences.t: Tom and I haven't seen each other since we were children.
sentences.ar: لم أرَ سامي مذ كنا صغارًا.

sentences.t: What do you wish for?
I wish I had more friends.
I wish I knew where he was!
I wish I could go to Japan.
I really wish to see you today.
I wish you had more time for me.
sentences.ar: أتمنى أن يكون لديك وقت أكثر لي.

sentences.t: I wish she could be here with us.
I wish I could remember her name.
I wish I had been kind to her then.
I wish you would do as you're told.
sentences.ar: أتمنى أن تفعل ما أُمِرت به.

sentences.t: I wish that I could do more to help.
sentences.ar: تمنّيت لو كنت قادرا على تقديم المزيد من المساعدة.

sentences.t: I wish there were more people like you.
sentences.ar: أتمنى لو كان هناك المزيد من الناس مثلك.

sentences.t: I just wish I knew how to speak French.
sentences.ar: أتمنتى فقط لو أستطعتُ تكلّمَ الفرنسيّةِ.

sentences.t: Those who do not wish to go need not go.
sentences.ar: هؤلاء الذين لا يردنا الذهاب، لا ضرورة لهم الذهاب.

sentences.t: I wish I didn't have to tell you this, but ...
sentences.ar: أتمنى لو لم يجب عليّ أن أخبرك هذا، ولكن...

sentences.t: Are you coming?
Ziri is coming.
Ziri was coming.
sentences.ar: كان زيري في طريقه إلى هنا.

sentences.t: No one is coming.
I am coming today.
I'm coming for you!
I'm coming with you.
Tom saw Mary coming.
sentences.ar: رأى توم ماري و هي قادمة.

sentences.t: Something is coming.
Who is coming with me?
Are you coming or not?
Tom is coming for you.
He's coming next week.
Ziri is coming with me.
